widgets_values:
## LTX-2.5 keyframes + optional dialog - RTX 3090

**Length**: group 2 `duration seconds` (5 -> 121 frames, 10 -> 241 frames @24fps). 10 s needs much more VRAM: use 768x448 or UD-Q5/Q4 if OOM.
**Resolution**: stage-1 width/height (/32); final = x2 (960x544 -> 1920x1088).

**Keyframes (anti-drift)**
- START: required. END: on by default (same characters, final positions). No END wanted -> Ctrl+B both `END guide` nodes.
- MID-A / MID-B: bypassed. To use one: Ctrl+B its LoadImage + preprocess + **both** guide nodes (stage 1 and 2).
- Set `frame_idx` to the frame where the image must appear (e.g. 5 s: 60 = middle; 10 s: 80, 160). Use the SAME value in both stages (if 2 stages). Any position, not only the middle.
- Keyframes must be the same scene/characters/lighting, only poses/positions change, else you get morphs/cuts.

**Dialog audio (pre-generated voices)**
- Bypassed by default -> LTX generates its own audio/speech from the prompt.
- To use your track: Ctrl+B the 4 nodes in group 4c + `Use dialog audio` node. The audio is locked (mask 0), LTX lip-syncs the video to it. Longer audio is cut, shorter is padded and the rest is generated.
- Make the audio the same length as the video (5 s / 10 s). Write in the prompt who says which line so the right mouth moves.

groups.title: 4. Keyframes: START + END on, MID-A / MID-B bypassed (Ctrl+B to toggle image AND both its guide nodes)
4c. DIALOG audio - bypassed by default. To use: select this group + 'Use dialog audio' node -> Ctrl+B
5b. Stage 2 - latent x2 upscale + refine (same keyframes)
